fresh_reproductions.root_cause: census-frozen.sh load_census() lines 360-382: header check is positional (fires only when line 1 is non-empty) and never verifies row field counts; field_at() pads missing fields as empty; numeric_change() accepts negative/empty numerics. One root cause family (compare-input validation), 6 manifestations.
